strand_a.title: PAMEC, Properties of Actinide Materials under Extreme Conditions (ActUsLab) 2026-1-RD-ACTUSLAB-PAMEC
strand_a.summary: The Properties of Actinide Materials under Extreme Conditions (PAMEC) facility consists of an ensemble of state-of-the-art installations designed for basic research on behaviour and properties of actinide materials under extreme conditions. Other third countries Most Horizon Europe calls are also open to participants from non-associated countries and international organisations, unless specific limitations or conditions are laid down in the work programme and/or the call/topic text, such as those highlighted for associated countries above. It is classified in Strand A because its verified content connects to Horizon Europe / FP10 international participation in a European policy context.
strand_a.relevance_note: Direct EU relevance; useful for tracking Horizon Europe / FP10 international participation.
